name: 48 — Gateway User JWT Tracking
description:
Tests Phase 3: Gateway optional user identification via JWT. Verifies that X-User-JWT header is parsed, user_id extracted, and recorded in gateway_requests table.

🔧 Gateway Config:
• Token: test-gateway-token-12345
• NO app assigned → Direct path (bypasses Temporal)
• Governance Profile: 'mock'
  - No rate limits
  - No PII guardrails
  - Logging: minimal

🎯 Test Goal:
• Send Gateway requests with X-User-JWT header
• Verify user_id is extracted from JWT claims
• Verify user_id is recorded in gateway_requests.user_id column
• Verify fail-open: invalid JWT doesn't break request

✅ Expected Behavior:
• All requests succeed (200 OK)
• Requests WITH valid JWT → user_id recorded in DB
• Requests WITHOUT JWT → user_id = NULL in DB
• Requests with INVALID JWT → user_id = NULL, request still succeeds

💡 Purpose: Validates Phase 3 implementation - Gateway can now track which the-M user made each request for quota enforcement.
